objective: Predict the exact geographic locations of Drone Congregation Areas (DCAs) within a 2km radius of Goldstream Honeyworks. Model the microclimates by combining topography, wind flow simulation (based on DEM), and thermal inertia (based on land cover and soil moisture). Identify the specific coordinates where temperature and wind conditions perfectly match the known requirements for Apis mellifera drone mating flights.
constraints: DCAs are typically located on south-facing slopes, near ridgelines, or specific landscape features that create thermal updrafts.
Cross-reference the predicted DCA locations with the foraging corridors to ensure they do not conflict with heavy forager traffic.
Provide the GPS coordinates of the top 3 predicted DCA zones.
Format the output for direct integration into the apiary management plan.
